units.source_text: 他抓住衬衫的领子，让空气灌进衣服里，一副精神抖擞、坐立不安的样子，他侧耳听了一会儿外边的动静。

en.t: He grabbed the collar of his shirt and let air flow inside his clothes; looking both invigorated and restless, he listened for a while to the sounds outside.

units.source_text: 对了，似乎还是熄了灯的好。

en.t: Yes, it seemed better to put out the light after all.

units.source_text: 他掀开灯罩，想要吹熄灯……

en.t: He lifted off the lampshade and was about to blow out the lamp...

units.source_text: 慢着，在这之前，再看一下女人的样子吧。

en.t: Wait, before that, he should take another look at the woman.

units.source_text: 脚上打的结十分牢固，连手指都插不进去。

en.t: The knot tied around her feet was so tight that he could not even slip a finger into it.

units.source_text: 手脖子已经肿起了黑红的印子，像刮刀似的指甲也变成旧墨水斑的颜色。

en.t: Her wrists had already swollen with dark red marks, and her scraper-like fingernails had turned the color of old ink stains.
